description.narrative: The Centre for Democracy and Governance (CDG) is an independent, Somaliland based nonprofit center of excellence that promotes the advancement of democracy and good governance. The deepening of democracy and works to contribute to peace and security in Somaliland, the African continent and beyond through dialogue, the pursuit of knowledge and rigorous analysis of critical issues and developments. In exercising this responsibility, CDG focuses on the challenges of institution building, democratic governance and the rule oflaw, as well as opportunities for peace, security, cooperation and integration. The CDG was established in 2017 and is a non-profit, non-governmental organization based in Hargeisa, Somaliland with a global scope. The CDG encourages engagement between electoral officials, electoral administrators, academic experts, the electorate, political parties, candidates and all other electoral stakeholders. It provides a forum for all electoral stakeholders and practitioners to interact with each other and discuss current international electoral trends and affairs, share research information and access and upload relevant news articles. This is a network that is dedicated to specific subject areas and gives individuals and organizations the latest information focusing on specific electoral issues. CDG promotes sustainable democratic development through the provision of advisory services and operational support in favor of electoral management bodies and national, regional and international organizations dealing with the implementation of the different steps of an electoral process.
